brightport_crate_failure_arrest.m: The guards grab you by your shoulders and restrain you. You try shaking them off, but you can't resist them. They put a blindfold over your eyes, and next thing you know, you're in a jail cell.

brightport_crateguard.m: Halt! What are you doing here?
r: I'm searching for my brother Andor, have you seen him?
That's private. Nothing you need to worry about.
Gentlemen. Has sir Gunfryk not told you to keep your noses out of places they don't belong?
I was patrolling the place to keep it safe from troublemakers, obviously.

brightport_crateguard0.m: What's with that tone?! We came here on a simple patrol but I think we might have caught a spy. We should arrest him, right partner?
r: Think about it twice. You try and arrest me, and by tomorrow morning you might find yourself discharged, or on a carriage to Feygard prison, signed off by Gunfryk himself.

brightport_crateguard1.m: Alright, alright, no need to get worked up. I think I've heard your name mentioned by the captain, so we'll trust him with this.

brightport_crateguard2.m: Ha, you're funny kid. And suspicious. Funny and suspicious. The commander himself ordered us to go on a patrol. So I think we've caught a troublemaker.
r: He might have ordered you to come here, but did he not tell you to keep your hands off Barthold and his friends? I happen to be one of those friends.

brightport_crateguard3.m: Wait, I think I know you. You're the kid who helped us with capturing those two criminals!

brightport_crateguard4.m: I guess you were the one the lookout spotted, so there is nothing else suspicious here. Either way, you did some impressive work with those two, but you shouldn't be hanging out around here. It's dangerous.
r: Anything for the glory of Feygard.

brightport_crateguard5.m: That's the spirit. We'll be heading back now, so follow behind us. Wouldn't want a future knight of Feygard getting hurt.
r: Sure, I'll be right behind you.

brightport_crateguard6.m: The two guards exchange a glance, then turn and leave the building.

brightport_crateguard7.m: Alright, got it. Never thought the commander would let someone suspicious like you run around, but we'll trust his judgment.

brightport_crateguard8.m: And we're supposed to believe that?

brightport_crateguard9.m: Calm down, our duty is to protect the citizens of this town. Maybe that cloaked figure was his brother.

brightport_crateguard_arrest.m: Ha! The commander can forgive a mistake or two. Grab him. We'll interrogate him later

brightport_crateguard_arrest3.m: I don't think so, we follow the law not the commander. You will be coming with us. We'll interrogate you later about what you were doing here.

brightport_guardcrate10.m: Hmph, fine. We'll ask you a few questions then. What would your brother be doing here?
r: We were playing hide and seek.
I don't know, I've been looking everywhere I can.

brightport_guardcrate11.m: Hide and seek. In an abandoned structure, ways from town?

brightport_guardcrate12.m: And I suppose your friends are hiding in the jail cell too, huh?

brightport_guardcrate14.m: Enough games. You're coming with us.

brightport_guardcrate15.m: You expect us to believe your brother's been the one wandering around this ruin?

brightport_guardcrate16.m: Sounds like an excuse to me. No one just wanders in here.

brightport_guardcrate17.m: Agreed. You're coming with us. The commander can sort this out.

brightport_thieves.10: The Thieves Guild was due to receive a package, but the guards in Brightport have been impeding their activities. They need a new face like me to pick the package up discretly. I was told to head east of the town.
brightport_thieves.20: I met the courier from Nor City inside the house.
brightport_thieves.30: Before we could conclude the meeting we heard the town guard making noise outside.
brightport_thieves.35: Thanks to some previous interactions I've had with the commander, I convinced the guards to let me go.
brightport_thieves.40: I couldn't fool the guards and got caught.
brightport_thieves.45: I managed to hide inside a crate and waited. Eventually, the guards left.
brightport_thieves.50: I delivered the package to Elysa, She was pleased with my work and said the Thieves Guild may have further opportunities for me in the future.
brightport_thieves.60: I lied to Gunfryk in a plot to kill him, and in the process the courier I was supposed to meet got arrested.
brightport_thieves.70: I failed to deliver the package to Elysa. She was not happy.

brightport_goons.10: Inside a house in Brightport, I met two people named Dynes and Barthold. It turned out that they are the friends Benbyr told me to visit. Rather lacking in hospitality, they offered me work.
brightport_goons.20: Barthold was hesitant because any job I could do for them would put me at odds with Gunfryk the guard commander. Taking that into account I offered to rid them of him.
brightport_goons.30: I was told not to kill him, but surely it won't be a problem if I do. Either way I'll resolve things for them.
brightport_goons.40: I received some records from silvear that could be useful as blackmail against Gunfryk.
brightport_goons.60: I used the records to blackmail Gunfryk. To save his reputation he begrudgingly agreed to give Barthold and Dynes some leeway.
brightport_goons.50: I lied to the commander that there are some lizardmen in the derelict house east of town, I should go there and prepare an ambush.
brightport_goons.70: I ambushed and killed Gunfryk in the house to the east, along with the two guards he brought.
brightport_goons.80: I informed the commander about Barthold and Dynes' scheme. He requested that I find some incriminating evidence of their role.
brightport_goons.110: I found some of the duo's merchandise in the smuggling cave east of brightport.
brightport_goons.130: I opted to blackmail the duo instead for some quick gold. Should've had the Guild's protection, suckers!
brightport_goons.135: I told the commander I couldn't find anything
brightport_goons.136: Barthold was disappointed in me for having done nothing about Gunfryk. Little did he know I lined my pockets with his merchandise.
brightport_goons.90: Barthold was happy with my work and gave me a reward, he said I could find more work like this in Nor City.
brightport_goons.100: Barthold was a little disappointed about me killing Gunfryk. It's possible that now Feygard might take more severe action with Brightport.
brightport_goons.120: Gunfryk was happy with my work, the duo will soon be jailed. He said Feygard needs more brave youngsters like me and that I should give the military academy a try.
brightport_goons.119: I gave the commander the blade, even though I already got paid not to. If there's any honor among Nor City's thieves, they will surely have none to spare for me.
brightport_goons.140: I told the commander I couldn't find anything, even though I had the blade I blackmailed Barthold and Dynes with.
